title: On Symmetric Kernel Collocation for Nonlinear PDEs
summary: This paper considers kernel-based approximation methods for nonlinear partial differential equations. To this end, the problem is formulated as an optimal-recovery generalized interpolation problem, that is, as an optimization problem in an RKHS with nonlinear functional constraints. This formulation provides the basis for a convergence analysis carried out directly in the RKHS and extends existing results by relaxing the uniqueness assumption on the PDE solution.
